description: This file defines the SearchQuerySelectDelegate class, which facilitates building and modifying search queries within the Hibernate Search integration of OpenMRS. It provides methods to set a final predicate, combine predicates, and specify projections for search results. The class is used internally to customize search query construction.

classes.name: SearchQuerySelectDelegate
classes.description: A delegate class for constructing and modifying Hibernate Search queries by setting predicates and projections. It extends an abstract delegating step and implements SearchQueryContributor for internal predicate customization.

methods.name: setFinalPredicate
methods.description: Sets the final predicate function to be applied to the search query.

methods.name: getFinalPredicate
methods.description: Retrieves the currently set final predicate function.

methods.name: where
methods.description: Adds a predicate to the search query, incorporating the final predicate if set. Overloaded to accept different predicate contributor types.

methods.name: select
methods.description: Defines the selection of fields or projections for the search query, wrapping the delegate's methods with additional predicate handling.

methods.name: selectEntity
methods.description: Specifies that the search should select an entity, wrapping the delegate.

methods.name: selectEntityReference
methods.description: Specifies selection as an entity reference, wrapping the delegate.
